mainEntity.name: Is per-minute or flat pricing cheaper?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on your calls. Per-minute billing can come out lower for a shop that gets a few short calls and never passes its bundle. Flat pricing is easier to predict: the bill does not move when a storm week doubles your calls. Kaico's receptionist is a $299 one-time setup, then $299 a month flat.
